description: A React hook implementation called useLocalStorage that manages a piece of state synchronized with localStorage, including JSON serialization and error handling.

methods.name: useLocalStorage(key, initialValue)
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides state management synchronized with localStorage, with safe JSON serialization and error handling. It returns the current value, a function to update it, and a function to reset it to the initial value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Function that resets the stored value to the initialValue.
